note: Woodson County (KS) publishes its zoning as text regulations (joint county and City of Yates Center zoning regulations on the county appraiser page) and a county map viewer. No public ArcGIS REST or downloadable zoning district polygon layer was found. The state ORKA services list only a SU- Zoning layer (Sumner-prefixed, not Woodson), and the county's own GIS is a property-map viewer. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online returned no Woodson zoning service.
